output_list.reason: The mint function allows the ICO smart contract to mint an arbitrary number of tokens, causing an overflow in the total supply, thus allowing the ICO to issue any amount of tokens to any address.
The burn function allows any address to burn any amount of tokens, enabling the token owner to arbitrarily decrease the total supply.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including smart contracts, without any restrictions, potentially allowing the owner to steal tokens.

The transferFrom function allows the owner to transfer tokens from the token holder's account to any address, including smart contracts, without any restrictions, potentially allowing the owner to steal tokens from any token holder.
The approve function allows the owner to approve any spender to spend any amount of tokens, enabling the spender to steal tokens from the owner.
